# Ant Farm Deluxe review

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.

# Ant Farm Deluxe review

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.

# Ant Farm Deluxe review

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.

# Ant Farm Deluxe review

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.

# Ant Farm Deluxe review

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.

# Ant Farm Deluxe review

The Ant Farm Deluxe is a two-chamber acrylic habitat for harvester ants that ships with a sand block, a feeding tray and a magnifier, and after six weeks of daily observation it is the enclosure we would recommend to a first-time keeper who wants to watch tunnels form without cleaning sand off the kitchen table every morning.

## What is in the box

- Two acrylic chambers connected by a 12 cm tube
- One sand block (blue, 400 g)
- Feeding tray, water dropper and a 3x magnifier

## Setup in three steps

1. Soak the sand block for ten minutes and press it into the main chamber.
2. Connect the tube and check both seals with the supplied key.
3. Introduce the ants through the top hatch and close it within thirty seconds.

## Measurements

| Metric | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chamber volume | 1.8 | litre |
| Tunnel length after 6 weeks | 142 | cm |
| Price paid | 39.90 | USD |

The feeding schedule below is what we used; the `feed()` call is from our logging script.

```
def feed(day):
    return "honey water" if day % 2 == 0 else "seed mix"
```

> Tunnels reached the second chamber on day nine, earlier than the manual suggests.

![Ant Farm Deluxe with two chambers and a magnifier](https://scrapingant.github.io/images/ant-farm-deluxe.jpg)

Verdict: worth the price for a first habitat; the magnifier is weak and the tube seals need checking every week. Read the [harvester ant care guide](https://scrapingant.github.io/guides/harvester-ants) before ordering.
